Previous F-1 fixed: the four Stale transitions are split into REQ-6, REQ-10, REQ-11, REQ-12, and REQ-13 states the outcome of rescheduling. Each REQ is one checkable behaviour.
Every known item cites the ticket, the context pack or an IDE answer (a-01..a-06); the cited answers say what the artifact claims.

Questions were real gaps with concrete options, including the new Q-05 on the rescheduled state; none remain open or blocking.
